items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I wanted an eight-week absence -- leave of absence to go play with Billy Williams... So I had to get a leave of absence from the owner. I wanted an eight-week absence -- leave of absence to go play with Billy Williams.

ctx.x: Yeah. Then you got back to Chicago in late '49, 1950, according to my reports. One thing -- I basically just have information during the 1950's that you had your own group, small group, mainly in Minneapolis and Vegas, and various places.

Minneapolis was the base -- the jumping off place, I should say, with Billy Williams. Billy Williams brought his Charioteers to this particular Key Club where my band was housed, and he loved this group that I had so much so that he said to me one day, "Hey man, I've got a date in Vegas at the Riviera Theatre." He said, "Would you like to go?" I said, "Oh yes, sure." He said, "Well, it's comin' up in about three months," He says, "I'm gonna play a couple of shows down in Kansas City, and I'll get back to you."…
